headline: Of 10 runs on Oct 1, 4 completed, 3 failed and 2 were cancelled; one is still running. The implement workflow produced most of the failures.
observations: 44% of runs completed (57% if cancelled runs are left out). Three of the four completed runs recorded an outcome of succeeded.
Two of the three failures happened in implement: a gate that timed out after 120000 ms, and a record script that exited 1.
One cancelled run carries a script error from its load node, so it is a failure in practice.
Spend is $5.00, and $2.00 (40%) went to a run that failed.
recommendations: Check the gate node's 120000 ms timeout in the implement workflow.
Look at why run r10 is still marked running; it has had no activity for a long time.

failure_notes.Timed out: gate: The gate script ran past its 120000 ms limit. Check whether the limit is too short for the checks it runs.
failure_notes.Workspace setup failed: The run never started because git could not create its worktree. This is an infrastructure fault, not a workflow defect.
failure_notes.Script failed: record: The record script exited with code 1 after the work finished; read the node output for the reason.
